title: Paper collage
summary: A 40-45 s narrated explainer, 16:9 and 9:16 from one project, in the Vox-style paper-collage look: a true story one sentence per scene, real photos cut out as white-border stickers, torn paper, clippings, stamps and typed labels landing on their words, over halftone b-roll, with captions and a sources end card.

optional.FAL_KEY (ElevenLabs via fal): narration with word timings, music, SFX, photo cut-outs (BiRefNet)
optional.BYTEPLUS_API_KEY (Seedance 2.0): generate b-roll; stock or your own footage works too

craft: a year, a person and a number in the first sentence
every piece lands on the word it belongs to
paper scenes alternate with b-roll scenes
the turn at about a quarter, the reveal at about three quarters
the last line spoken and shown word for word

style.ground: paper texture; b-roll desaturated under an 8 px halftone screen, paper grain and a vignette
style.type: Anton capitals for names and numbers, Special Elite for typed labels, Inter for captions
style.accent: one red, one yellow, on strips, stamps and highlighter only
banned: redrawn or AI-altered photos of real people
style.motion: slaps, rises, drops and stamps at small tilts; a slow push on every scene

generators: Seedance 2.0 (BytePlus) b-roll, 5 shots of 5 s, no people
ElevenLabs multilingual v2 narration with word timings via fal
ElevenLabs Music and Sound Effects via fal
tool.assets: tools/cutout.py makes white-border stickers from licensed photos; tools/voice.py writes words.json

reference.name: Vox-style paper-collage explainers; prompted by a frame from an AI-agent-made narrated biography shared on LinkedIn

result.example_story: Sam Bankman-Fried and his 2022 Anthropic stake, the week Anthropic filed to go public (unofficial explainer)

from_story: a true story that fits in eight sentences, with a source for every fact
2-3 licensed photos of the people in it (Wikimedia Commons first)
logos, a chart or a document if the story has them
one number or turn worth stamping
generated: one b-roll shot per b-roll scene, no people (tools/footage.md)

fits: news explainers: an IPO, a collapse, a verdict, a deal
short biographies of founders and public figures
company histories and 'how did we get here' stories
feed posts that need 16:9 and 9:16 and play muted
avoid: stories without licensed photos of the people in them
rumours or anything a source cannot back
stories that need more than about 60 s

licence.photos: Cointelegraph and MIT Bitcoin Club photos CC BY 3.0, detention photo public domain, FTT chart CC0, via Wikimedia Commons (see project/assets/THIRD_PARTY.md)
licence.logos: Anthropic and FTX logos are trademarks of their owners; shown as part of reporting
